_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#1, a signal-text correction. Measured on skfem 12.0.1: reading the outward normal as w.n in a form assembled against a plain CellBasis raises AttributeError("Attribute 'n' not found in 'w'.") -- the message names the FormExtraParams dict w, NOT the Basis, so the prior signal "'Basis' object has no attribute 'normals'" is a string skfem 12.0.1 never emits. On MeshTri().refined(2): 56 facets, 16 on the boundary; FacetBasis covers those 16 and InteriorFacetBasis the other 40.
